name: Entity Recycle
description: Adds the ability to restore deleted entities.
project_description: Entity Recycle provides recycle-bin / trash functionality for content entities. Instead of permanently deleting an entity, deleting it moves the entity to a recycle bin from which it can be restored, protecting against accidental deletion. Technically the module adds a locked boolean field named recycle_bin to the enabled entity types/bundles; when that field is TRUE the entity is considered to be in the bin and is unpublished. Only users with the appropriate recycle-bin permissions can view, restore, or permanently delete binned items. An optional purge time (in minutes) lets cron permanently delete items that have sat in the bin beyond that age. A 'Content Recycle Bin' view (admin/content/node/recycle-bin) lists binned nodes. Requires only Drupal core (node). By default it does not filter recycled items out of other existing views; the README shows how to exclude them with a recycle_bin field filter or hook_views_query_alter().
